deals.desc: Harris Teeter's weekly ad features a fully cooked Traditional Turkey Dinner serving 6 to 8, including turkey, stuffing, mashed potatoes, gravy and more, for $69.99.

deals.deal: Buy $50 in Gift Cards, Get a Free $10 Bonus Card
deals.desc: Buy $50 or more in Panera gift cards in-cafe, in the app or online and receive a free $10 bonus card redeemable in January, no code needed.

deals.deal: $7 Regular Ramen with Code RAMEN7
deals.desc: Any regular-sized ramen bowl for $7 through November 15: enter code RAMEN7 at noodles.com checkout or give the code at the counter. Open to everyone, no account needed; one per order, not on third-party delivery or catering, participating locations, while the chain's redemption cap lasts. The code and its terms are on Noodles' own offers terms page.

deals.deal: Free Delivery on Every Order Through the End of 2026
deals.desc: Through the end of 2026, delivery orders placed on mezeh.com or in the Mezeh app carry no delivery fee, for anyone, no code or account needed. Build-your-own bowls, wraps and family packs all qualify. Stated on Mezeh's own homepage.

deals.deal: Free 16 oz Cold Brew with a Chocolate Coconut Joy or Chocolate Covered Strawberry Bowl for Playa Rewards Members
deals.desc: Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 13: Playa Rewards members (free account) get a free 16 oz Playola or Sweet Cream Cold Brew with the purchase of a Chocolate Coconut Joy Bowl or Chocolate Covered Strawberry Bowl, in the shop, on playabowls.com or in the app for pickup. One redemption per member, modifiers extra, not valid on third-party delivery; participating shops while supplies last. Stated on Playa Bowls' own current-promotions page.

deals.deal: Free Birria Grilled Burrito Dipper with Any Purchase for Moe Rewards Members
deals.desc: Through Sunday, November 22: Moe Rewards members (free account) get one Grilled Burrito Dipper with the returning shredded-beef Birria free with any purchase, in the app, online or in the restaurant. Single use; the fine print says the offer goes to select members, so check the Rewards tab in the app before ordering. Not valid with dipper pans, other offers or third-party delivery; participating locations. Stated on moes.com.

deals.deal: Throwback Thursdaze: Burrito or Bowl + Chips + Drink for $8.99
deals.desc: Every Thursday at participating locations: a Tijuana Burrito or burrito bowl plus chips and a drink for $8.99 in-store, online, or in the app - no third-party delivery; pricing varies slightly by location.

deals.deal: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
deals.desc: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it.

deals.deal: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
deals.desc: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations.

deals.deal: Buy One, Get One Free Gyros, Pitas or Appetizers with Code BOGO, Online Orders
deals.desc: Limited time at Michigan locations: add two qualifying items from the same category on the chain's own ordering site (for example a Chicken Great Greek Gyro, Feta-Filled Kebab Gyro or Falafel Pita, $10.99 to $12.99 each) and enter promo code BOGO at checkout to get one free. One BOGO per order; categories cannot be mixed; no account needed. Seen on the Byron Center, Ann Arbor, West Bloomfield, Troy and Allen Park ordering pages.

deals.deal: Choose Two for $8.99 with Code 1551: Half Salad, Soup, Sandwich or Pasta Plus a Side
deals.desc: Limited time at select cafes: any Choose Two combo (two of a half salad, half soup, half sandwich or half pasta) plus a side for $8.99, all day. Enter code 1551 at online checkout or mention it in the cafe; no account needed, not valid on third-party delivery. The offer is set cafe by cafe: it shows for Fair Oaks in Fairfax, Bethesda, both DC cafes and cafes in Illinois, Texas, Georgia, Pennsylvania and Tennessee, so pick your cafe on Corner Bakery's offers page to confirm before you go.
